name: Exp_ColorX2MA_Digit_NN3_MMRec
summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses a double smoothed moving average (ColorX2MA) with digital filtering and a 3-layer neural network (NN3) for signal generation. It incorporates money management recommendations (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters. The system enters trades on crossover signals confirmed by the neural network classifier and manages exits via trailing stops or opposite signals.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个趋势跟踪型专家顾问，使用双平滑移动平均线（ColorX2MA）配合数字滤波和三层神经网络（NN3）生成交易信号。它集成了资金管理推荐（MMRec）模块，根据账户权益和风险参数动态调整仓位。系统在交叉信号经神经网络确认后入场，通过追踪止损或反向信号出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorX2MA双平滑移动平均线的交叉信号来判断趋势方向，当快线上穿慢线时做多，下穿时做空。数字滤波（Digit）模块对价格数据进行预处理以减少噪声，提高信号质量。三层神经网络（NN3）作为信号确认层，对MA交叉信号进行二次验证，过滤掉低质量的假突破信号。资金管理推荐（MMRec）模块根据账户权益、风险比例和止损距离动态计算每笔交易的仓位大小，实现风险可控的资金管理。出场机制包括追踪止损和反向信号平仓两种方式，确保在趋势反转时及时退出。整体策略融合了传统技术指标与机器学习方法，试图在趋势跟踪的稳健性和信号精确度之间取得平衡。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the ColorX2MA double smoothed moving average to determine trend direction, going long when the fast line crosses above the slow line and short when it crosses below. The digital filtering (Digit) module preprocesses price data to reduce noise and improve signal quality. The three-layer neural network (NN3) serves as a signal confirmation layer, providing secondary verification of MA crossover signals to filter out low-quality false breakout signals. The money management recommendation (MMRec) module dynamically calculates position size for each trade based on account equity, risk ratio, and stop-loss distance, achieving risk-controlled capital management. Exit mechanisms include both trailing stops and opposite signal closing, ensuring timely exits when trends reverse. The overall strategy integrates traditional technical indicators with machine learning methods, attempting to strike a balance between the robustness of trend following and signal precision.

pros: 融合神经网络与传统技术指标，双重信号确认机制减少假信号
内置资金管理推荐模块，根据账户权益动态调整仓位，风险可控
数字滤波预处理降低价格噪声，提高信号质量和稳定性
pros_en: Integrates neural network with traditional technical indicators, dual signal confirmation reduces false signals
Built-in money management recommendation module dynamically adjusts position size based on account equity for controlled risk
Digital filtering preprocessing reduces price noise, improving signal quality and stability
cons: 神经网络在MetaTrader 5中的实现通常为前馈预训练模型，缺乏在线学习能力，无法适应市场regime变化
双平滑MA本质上是滞后指标，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假突破信号导致连续亏损
策略复杂度较高，参数过多可能导致过拟合，且回测结果可能不具前瞻性
cons_en: Neural network implementation in MetaTrader 5 is typically a pre-trained feedforward model lacking online learning capability, unable to adapt to market regime changes
Double smoothed MA is inherently a lagging indicator, prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
High strategy complexity with many parameters may lead to overfitting, and backtesting results may lack forward validity
improvements: 增加市场regime识别模块，在震荡市中自动降低仓位或暂停交易，避免趋势策略在非趋势环境中的亏损
为神经网络添加定期再训练机制，使模型能够适应当前市场特征的变化
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification module that automatically reduces position size or pauses trading in ranging markets, avoiding losses from trend strategies in non-trending environments
Add periodic retraining mechanism for the neural network so the model can adapt to changes in current market characteristics

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损，缺乏明确的市场状态切换保护
神经网络预训练模型无法适应市场结构突变，可能在黑天鹅事件中失效
risk_points_en: Trend following strategy may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking clear market state switching protection
Pre-trained neural network model cannot adapt to sudden market structural changes and may fail during black swan events

summary_en: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses a double smoothed moving average (ColorX2MA) with digital filtering and a 3-layer neural network (NN3) for signal generation. It incorporates money management recommendations (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters. The system enters trades on crossover signals confirmed by the neural network classifier and manages exits via trailing stops or opposite signals.
